plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked infant gut colonization & lactic-acid fermentation chart from Escherich (14 July 1885, Fortschritte der Medicin) and Metchnikoff (1907, The Prolongation of Life) shows a newborn's sterile digestive tract reaching >10⁹–10¹⁰ bacteria per gram of colon contents within days of birth, alongside Lactobacillus bulgaricus fermenting milk lactose into lactic acid (pH ~4.0–4.5) to suppress putrefactive microbes.
